items.headline: U.S. Forces Strike Iranian Radar Sites After Drone Attack Near Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: American forces conducted retaliatory strikes against Iranian coastal radar installations following Iran's launch of drones toward the strategically critical Strait of Hormuz shipping lane. The exchange represents a significant escalation in Gulf tensions and demonstrates continued Iranian willingness to threaten global energy chokepoints. Watch for potential Iranian counter-escalation and impacts on regional oil transport.

items.headline: France Deploys AI-Powered Military Command System in NATO Exercise
items.summary: The French Army will test 'Berthier,' its proprietary large language model designed for battlefield staff operations, during upcoming NATO exercises this month. This marks a significant step in military AI adoption by a major NATO ally, potentially setting precedents for alliance-wide artificial intelligence integration. The system's performance could influence broader NATO AI strategy and interoperability standards.

items.headline: Pentagon Removes 180 Faiths from Official Recognition List in Administrative Overhaul
items.summary: The Department of Defense eliminated 180 religious and belief categories from its official recognition system, citing administrative complexity as the primary driver. While Pentagon officials characterize this as routine administrative streamlining, the change affects religious accommodation processes for service members. Monitor for potential legal challenges and impacts on military chaplaincy services.
